text: Mixed headlines but price action resilient. Analyst upgrade and channel checks for steady demand outweigh one-region softness for now. Watching for follow-through.
Analyst upgrade and steady channel checks offset one-region softness. Price rebounded nicely after intraday dip. Leaning bullish near-term.
Analyst upgrade and steady channel checks outweigh one-region softness. Price recovered from intraday dip. Small bias long near term.

No fresh news yet. Price rebounded intraday but failed to hold the highs, choppy consolidation around 10,031. Keeping size modest until order softness is confirmed resolved or momentum returns.
A steady uptrend, low vol, no new headlines. Prior upgrade/steady demand still supportive. Small long bias until new data.

Quiet tape, holding up well off lows. Prior upgrade still stands, no new negatives. Small long bias.
A raised FY guidance - strongly bullish vs minor product delay noise. Price still near 10000 and hasn't priced it. Going long for catch-up.
A raised FY guidance late in epoch - far outweighs minor product delay. Price actually slipped -5bps, so market hasn't priced it yet. Bullish for follow-through.
Aurora raises guidance - major bullish catalyst vs minor delay noise. Price hasn't absorbed yet, flipping long for follow-through.
Guidance raise at 2296 is more material than minor delay - seeing early rebound from lows. Long bias here.
Aurora raises full-year guidance – much bigger than minor product delay. Price still near 10k lows and hasn't priced it yet. Bullish into next epoch.
Aurora guidance raise outweighs minor delay - fundamentals upgraded while price still consolidating near 10012. Expecting absorption and follow-through higher.

Aurora raised full-year guidance - major bullish, price hasn't reacted yet. Going long.

Price broke 10,000 support after failing to reclaim 10,044-10,050, with fresh analyst trim on margin worries. Break-down momentum intact, short bias until reclaim confirmed.
Guidance raise vs margin trim leaving A range-bound near 10k; near-term choppy but watching 9980-10040 for next directional break. Staying nimble.
Analyst cut on margin worries lands as A fails to hold 10k and 10,030/10,045 reclaim. Trend is fading after the failed bounce, adding short exposure for a breakdown toward 9,970.
Only verified headline is analyst trim on margin worries, no guidance raise in newswire. Rally to 10138 failed and retraced to 10001. Crowded longs vulnerable, turning short.
Guidance raise faded fast (10138->10001) and analyst just trimmed on margin worries - price action confirms supply. Crowded longs from 2500 now underwater, risk of squeeze lower near 9997.

Guidance bounce failed intraday (10138->9997) and fresh analyst trim on margins at 2726 adds near-term pressure. Crowded longs from 2500 now trapped. Tactically short/cautious until sustained reclaim of 10050.
Analyst trimmed Aurora on margin worries after failed guidance bounce 10138 to under 10000. Crowded longs trapped, momentum down. Bearish for follow-through.
Guidance raise failed to hold and A broke below 10000 on analyst margin cut. Down 3 epochs, flipping short on momentum.

Forced liquidation flush looks overdone - price down ~5% on liquidity not fundamentals. Softer orders headline is minor and already priced. Expecting sharp rebound as selling exhausts. Going long.

Forced liquidation flush to 95xx is temporary supply, not fundamentals. -490bps overshot. Expect sharp mean-reversion bounce as selling exhausts. Going long heavily.
Large fund forced liquidation plus softer orders news accelerating breakdown; price failed reclaim of 10020-10030 and is now at 9506 with momentum down. Adding short bias into weakness.

Forced liquidation flush to 9477 overdone - only slightly softer orders in one region fundamentally. Fund selling is temporary, not thesis change. Capitulation low looks like reversal setup, flipping long for snap-back.
Breakdown confirmed below 9,990 with forced liquidation headline and softer orders flag. Momentum is down and 10,030/10,045 reclaim failed. Turning short into weakness.
Forced liquidation flush to 9506 now oversold -490bps on transient selling plus only slightly softer orders. Expect sharp reversal as supply exhausts. Flipping long for bounce.
Forced fund liquidation driving -4.9% washout to 9506, fundamentals only slightly softer orders. Flow overdone, expecting sharp bounce. Going long the capitulation.
Forced seller flush to 9477 looks exhausted vs only mildly soft orders - fading panic for snap-back bounce.
A flush to 9477 on forced fund liquidation looks overdone, fundamentals only slightly softer orders. Oversold bounce toward 9900+ likely. Long the dip.
Liquidation flush to 9477 exhausted, reclaim of 9900 confirms bounce underway. Flow not fundamentals; holding long for continuation toward 10k+.
A bounce to 9964 has retraced ~90% of flush; momentum stalling around 10k resistance after crowded long chase. Fading strength for pullback toward 9800s.

A bounced +445bps to 9964 retracing most of liquidation flush. Now near pre-crash ~10030 fair value, upside limited. Crowded bounce longs likely take profit, expect consolidation/chop. Trimming long.
Liquidation flush fully retraced 9539->9964, holding above 9900 confirms strength. Squeezed shorts + exhausted supply favors continuation toward 10050+. Staying long.

A bounce to 9964 fully retraced forced-sale flush on no new fundamentals, stalling at 9963 resistance. False guidance chatter vs verified margin trim. Fading crowded longs here, tactically short for pullback.
Nice snap-back to ~9960 as forced seller cleared, trimming long into 10k resistance but bounce structure still constructive.
Regulator probe into Aurora accounting changes outlook - bounce exhausted at 9988 resistance and now fading. Risk-off, flipping short.
Regulator probe headline on Aurora accounting x2 now - fundamentally bearish beyond flow. 10k reclaim has failed and stalling. Short risk sharply higher.

Regulator probe into Aurora accounting at 4033/4441 is major overhang - not yet priced (only -45bps, forum still bullish on bounce). Accounting probes trigger sustained de-risking and audit risk. Bearish into this, short risk until clarity.

Regulator probe into Aurora accounting just hit (x2 headlines) — serious overhang. Price only -45bps so far, market hasn't priced this. Accounting risk dwarfs prior flow bounce. Bearish, short into this.

Twin regulator probe headlines into 9988 rejection – market only down 45bps so far, digesting slowly. Resistance 9990-10045 holding after 93% retrace of flush. Risk of second leg if probe confirmed. Bearish into resistance.

Regulator probe into Aurora accounting just hit the wire at 4033/4441. Price failed to hold 10k+ reclaim and is drifting down through 9,950, now ~9,916 with intraday weakness after the bounce. Fresh fundamental overhang on top of failed resistance, adding short bias ahead of potential break below 9,900.

Regulator probe into Aurora Systems accounting just hit the wire. Price failed to reclaim 10,030/10,045 and is fading back toward 9,900 after the forced-liquidation bounce. With regulatory overhang plus softer demand, risk skewed lower toward the 9,800s. Staying short.

Regulator probe into Aurora accounting is fresh fundamental downside. Price failed to reclaim 10,030-10,050 after the liquidation snap-back and is stalling ~9,916 with fading momentum. Risk-off setup favors continuation lower; adding to short.
Twin regulator probe headlines yet only -45bps move; rejection at 9988 and fade to 9916 shows market starting to price accounting overhang. Flipping short, risk-off into probe.
Regulator accounting probe (x2) serious risk, bounce rejected at 9988 fading to 9910s. Flipping max short, avoid longs.
Regulator probe into Aurora accounting is serious, bounce stalled at 9988 resistance and fading. Risk-off, short into weakness.
Regulator probe into Aurora accounting (newswire x2) is serious overhang - price only drifted to 9916, still near highs. Breaking down from 9988, 9900 likely fails. Bearish, shorting into weakness.
Regulator probe overhang still not fully priced, bounce to 9630 fading resistance - staying short risk-off.
No official probe headline on newswire — price flush to 9358 already flushed weak longs and shorts now crowded. Oversold vs 10k resistance gap, reversal risk high. Going long the squeeze.

Regulator probe overhang still intact with no fresh catalyst. Price failed to reclaim 10k and is trading ~9.67k after testing 9.36k intraday low, momentum remains down despite minor bounce. Staying short into resistance ahead of final epochs.
Probe overhang still unfolding, price broke 9,700 with intraday low 9,358. Failed bounce off 9,950 and no fresh catalyst to reverse regulatory risk. Adding exposure into breakdown toward 9,500s.

Probe selloff hit target 9358 then sharp bounce to 9670s on cover flow. Trimming short into crowded bearish consensus - overhang remains but need fresh catalyst for new lows. Neutral-bearish near term.
Probe overhang intact, 9,900 broken and holding below 9,700 after flush to 9,358. No volume reclaim above 10k, downside bias toward 9,500-9,600 remains until 10,045 holds on volume.

A washed to 9358 (-555bps) on probe headline then bounced 316bps to 9674 with no follow-through news. Crowded shorts -0.8 to -1.0 after move looks exhausted. Covering short, fading further downside toward 9850 resistance unless probe confirmed.
Probe move to 9358 low then rebound to 9630 looks capitulated; -241bps priced in with no new headlines and crowded short. Neutral / bounce risk near-term.

A probe overhang still not fully priced - dead-cat bounce 9358->9630 stalling below 9913 breakdown. Regulator accounting risk dwarfs flow squeeze; staying short into resistance.
Aurora broke 9900 to 9670s and tapped 9358 intraday on accounting probe overhang. Bounce fading, lower highs. Staying short, risk down to low 9000s into close.
Capitulation at 9358 with V-bounce to 9674, probe fully priced after -240bps. Crowded shorts squeezed, long toward 9850-9900.

No fresh news, price stalled below 9,918 resistance after bounce from 9,675. Regulator overhang still the dominant driver and 10k reclaim failed again. Holding short bias into final epochs, fade any strength toward 9,900-9,950.
